status: Source-backed journal data; not independently gameplay-verified
notes: 31 records: 7 magic, 7 summons, 7 items, 8 friends, 2 specials. Not a full Card Index denominator: map/world/gimmick/minigame cards and Riku are separate. Friends are battle pickups, not permanent deck copies.

records.name: Fire
records.effect: Launches a fire projectile. Two Fire cards cast Fira; three cast Firaga.
records.useParameters: Power: 5×; fire element.

records.name: Blizzard
records.acquisition: Traverse Town tutorial: break the barrel in Unknown Room.
records.effect: Deals ice damage. Two Blizzard cards cast Blizzara; three cast Blizzaga.
records.useParameters: Power: 4×; ice element.

records.name: Thunder
records.effect: Deals lightning damage. Two Thunder cards cast Thundara; three cast Thundaga.
records.useParameters: Power: 3.5×; lightning element.

records.name: Cure
records.effect: Restores HP. Two Cure cards cast Cura; three cast Curaga.
records.useParameters: Restores 50 HP before modifiers.

records.name: Gravity
records.effect: Deals damage proportional to remaining enemy HP. Two cards cast Gravira; three cast Graviga.
records.useParameters: Base damage: 20% of current target HP, subject to resistance.

records.name: Stop
records.effect: Temporarily stops enemies. Two cards cast Stopra; three cast Stopga.
records.useParameters: Base duration: 3 seconds on susceptible enemies.

records.name: Aero
records.effect: Damages and blows away nearby enemies. Two cards cast Aerora; three cast Aeroga.
records.useParameters: Power: 3×; neutral element.

records.name: Simba
records.acquisition: Traverse Town: finish Room of Beginnings.
records.effect: Roars at enemies ahead. Stacking adds stun.
records.useParameters: Power: 3×; neutral element.

records.name: Genie
records.effect: Casts Thundara, Gravira or Stopra. Stacking increases spell count.
records.useParameters: One random spell: Thundara power 6×, Gravira 40% current HP, or Stopra 8 seconds; target resistance applies.

records.name: Bambi
records.effect: Drops healing orbs while running. Stacking improves healing.
records.useParameters: Drops small HP orbs; contact power 0.1× per hit.
records.durationEvidence: Consulted technique page supplies qualitative duration but no exact Re:CoM seconds.

records.name: Dumbo
records.effect: Sprays an ice-element stream. Stacking extends its duration.
records.useParameters: Ice damage, power 1.5× per hit; aim the stream with movement input.
records.durationEvidence: Consulted technique page supplies qualitative duration but no exact Re:CoM seconds.

records.name: Tinker Bell
records.effect: Heals repeatedly for a limited time. Stacking improves healing.
records.useParameters: Lasts 3 seconds; base healing 7% max HP plus 0.5% per repeated reaction input.

records.name: Mushu
records.acquisition: Hollow Bastion: base Room of Rewards chest.
records.effect: Breathes fire. Stacking extends its duration.
records.useParameters: Aim manually while stationary; power 1× per fireball. Ends at 11 seconds or 10 shots.

records.name: Cloud
records.acquisition: Olympus Coliseum: finish Room of Truth.
records.effect: Makes two sword strikes. Two cards use Cross-slash; three use Omnislash.
records.useParameters: Two sword attacks; stock two for Cross-slash or three for Omnislash.

records.name: Potion
records.effect: Instantly reloads reloadable attack cards; spent attack cards stay unavailable.

records.name: Hi-Potion
records.acquisition: Olympus Coliseum: finish Room of Guidance.
records.effect: Instantly restores attack cards, including normally unreloadable attack cards.

records.name: Mega-Potion
records.effect: Restores all attack cards, including normally unreloadable cards, and resets the reload counter.

records.name: Ether
records.effect: Instantly reloads reloadable magic and summon cards; spent cards stay unavailable.

records.name: Mega-Ether
records.effect: Restores magic and summon cards, including normally unreloadable cards, and resets the reload counter.

records.name: Elixir
records.effect: Restores attack, magic and summon cards, including normally unreloadable cards.

records.name: Megalixir
records.acquisition: Destiny Islands: base Room of Rewards chest.
records.effect: Restores attack, magic and summon cards, including normally unreloadable cards, and resets the reload counter.

records.name: Donald Duck
records.acquisition: Battle pickup from the start; temporarily absent after the 11F Exit Hall Riku Replica battle until the 12F Exit Hall Larxene battle.
records.effect: Casts two random Fire, Blizzard, Thunder or Cure spells.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: Two random spells; spell choice does not avoid enemy elemental resistance.

records.name: Goofy
records.acquisition: Battle pickup from the start; temporarily absent after the 11F Exit Hall Riku Replica battle until the 12F Exit Hall Larxene battle.
records.effect: Spins around Sora, striking with his shield.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: Neutral damage, power 1.5× per hit.
records.durationEvidence: Consulted technique page supplies qualitative duration but no exact Re:CoM seconds.

records.name: Aladdin
records.effect: Slashes while running; hits release Moogle Points.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: Lasts 3 seconds; power 2× per hit; each hit produces three small Moogle Point orbs.

records.name: Jack
records.effect: Casts Fire, Blizzard, Thunder or Gravity.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: One spell: Fire power 6×, Blizzard 5×, Thunder 4×, or Gravity 10% remaining HP.

records.name: Ariel
records.effect: Spins across the battlefield, hitting enemies.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: Two hits: power 4.5× then 5×. Follow the reaction prompt; a wrong input ends the attack.

records.name: Peter Pan
records.acquisition: Neverland battle pickup after entering Room of Beginnings; absent from entry into Room of Guidance until entry into Room of Truth.
records.effect: Dagger attacks; repeated reaction-button presses accelerate attacks and release Moogle Points.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: Lasts 7 seconds; neutral power 2× per hit.

records.name: Beast
records.effect: Knocks enemies toward Sora for return hits.
records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: Three hits: power 3×, 1×, 5×; use the reaction prompt for Sora’s return hit.

records.name: Pluto
records.acquisition: After entering Traverse Town’s Room of Beginnings, Pluto can replace a friend-card spawn with 20% probability when Sora has at most 2 cards left and at most 9 reloadable cards.
records.effect: Digs up cards and prize orbs.

appearanceCondition.unlockedBy: Enter Traverse Town Room of Beginnings

records.appearanceVerification: All eight friend unlock/world windows checked against Friend Card remake table, 2026-10-01.
records.useParameters: May recover up to 3 spent cards, or 3 large HP and Moogle Point orbs each. A bone scatters about 10% of held Moogle Points; nothing is another outcome.

records.name: Gold Card
records.acquisition: Collect all 150 other card types, including the Days bonus cards. Open a new Bounty-room chest to obtain Gold Card.

notes.title: Effect
notes.text: Premium Guard allows Premium cards to reload for five reloads.

notes.title: Finding the chest
notes.text: Create a Calm Bounty, Guarded Trove or False Bounty room. Collect any earlier world-specific bounty rewards, then create another room. Castle Oblivion on 13F is a convenient place to finish this sequence.

records.name: Platinum Card
records.acquisition: After obtaining Gold Card, open another new Bounty-room chest to obtain Platinum Card.

notes.title: Finding the chest
notes.text: Create a Calm Bounty, Guarded Trove or False Bounty room. Collect any earlier world-specific bounty rewards, then create another room. Castle Oblivion on 13F is a convenient place to finish this sequence.
